battle.name: 紫金山之戰
battle.brief: 顯德三年（956）秋起，周世宗柴榮再征淮南，戰線壓到淮河南岸壽縣紫金山。南唐齊王李景達的援軍在此連營十餘座，與被圍的壽州遙相呼應，並掘地道數十里輸糧。後周以趙匡胤為先鋒奪寨斷其甬道，翌年四月攻破本寨，五萬援軍潰散。卡面斯巴達長矛是「長兵結陣」的象徵，此役決勝的卻是弩、浮橋與水軍。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 紫金山之戰是五代後周與南唐在淮南戰線上的一場攻守之戰，交戰地帶集中在淮河南岸壽縣一帶的紫金山營寨，與被圍的壽州城互為表裏。此處的紫金山在今安徽壽縣東北、淮河南岸，與金陵城外的紫金山並非一地，不可混淆。交戰的一方是後周：皇帝柴榮自領中軍，樞密使李穀、同平章事范質與王溥參贊軍務，殿前司與殿前都指揮使張永德、李繼勳統率禁軍，趙匡胤領先鋒，李重進獨當一面，向訓以淮南節度使兼沿江招討使總督淮南戰線，趙晁與王環分掌水軍，趙匡贊領伏兵之役。禁軍序列分殿前司與殿前都點檢，之下有虎捷左右廂、龍武、飛熊、虎衛諸軍，步騎分置；攻城別設專司，糧秣靠汴河與淮河的水運，築城靠沿線丁夫徵發。另一方是南唐：主李璟坐鎮金陵，以齊王李景達統率援軍，宣州、濠州、泗州、壽州各置節度使與守將，陳覺與李景達共掌軍務，宋齊丘以中書身份節制諸軍。兩軍的勝負都繫於淮河這條水道：後周自汴河造艦下淮，水陸並行；南唐倚長江之利，靠連環寨壘、可移浮橋與火船維持淮南防線。
countriesEn: The Battle of Zijin Mountain was an offensive-defensive engagement on the Huai River front between the Later Zhou and Southern Tang in the Five Dynasties period. The fighting area was concentrated on the Zijin Mountain camp on the south bank of the Huai near Shou County, which faced the besieged city of Shouzhou and together with it formed a single defensive system. The Zijin Mountain in question lies north-east of Shou County in modern Anhui, on the south bank of the Huai; it is not the Purple Mountain outside Jinling, and the two should not be confused. One side was the Later Zhou: Emperor Chai Rong commanded the central army in person, the Military Secretariat commissioner Li Gu and the chancellors Fan Zhi and Wang Pu advised on operations, the Palace Guard offices under Zhang Yongde and Li Jixun held the imperial army, Zhao Kuangyin led the vanguard, Li Chongjin took charge of one wing, Xiang Xun served as Huainan jiedushi and commander of the riverside advance with overall authority over the Huainan front, Zhao Chao and Wang Huan commanded the river fleet, and Zhao Kuangzan led the ambush detachment. The guard system was divided between the dianqian si and the dianqian di dianjian, with the hujie left and right xiang and the Longwu, Feixiong and Huwei formations beneath them, infantry and cavalry listed separately; siege work had its own specialists, grain moved by boat along the Bian and the Huai, and new walls were built with corvée labour drawn from the counties on the line. The other side was Southern Tang: the ruler Li Jing sat in Jinling with his Qi prince Li Jingda commanding the relief force, Xuan, Hao, Si and Shou each had a jiedushi and a garrison commander, Chen Jue and Li Jingda shared control of military affairs, and Song Qiqiu, as head of the Secretariat, held the leash on the various commands. The fortunes of both sides turned on the Huai as a water route: the Later Zhou built warships on the Bian and sent them downriver to fight on water and land together, while Southern Tang relied on the Yangtze, holding its Huainan line through chained camps, a movable pontoon bridge and fire ships.
people: 此役中真正決定節奏的是柴榮。他是五代諸君中少數親自到前線督戰的君主：顯德四年三月廿一日自大梁出發，三月晦日抵下蔡，四月初四夜渡淮河，初五日出戰，初七日破寨，一路追擊二百餘里至荊山洪。柴榮用人的方式極硬，破寨之後仍分兵固守新據點；據《資治通鑑》記載，部將樊愛能、何徽報稱攻破紫金山寨，柴榮遣人偵察，發覺二人正在博戲場中取樂，遂將其腰斬於軍中。同樣的例子是李穀，臥病在床仍上言「壽春馬上可以攻下，這時候只要陛下親征就行」，促成第二次親征。南唐一方則是自己把形勢推垮：主李璟屢問臣下是否當親征，得到的答案都是不可行；齊王李景達為援軍主帥卻受制於陳覺，軍中五萬人竟無戰意；將領朱元因受猜忌而整寨上萬人降周，裨將時厚卿不肯降反被朱元所殺；壽州守將劉仁贊固守年餘，病到不能視人，最後由監軍使周廷構、營田副使孫羽以他的名義出降，兒子劉崇讓奉詔出城迎接。趙匡胤是此役最鋒利的尖兵，他以殿前都指揮使兼先鋒破先鋒寨，又以砍皮帽、斬怠戰者的辦法立軍法。
peopleEn: The man who set the pace in this campaign was Chai Rong. He was one of the few Five Dynasties rulers who repeatedly took the field in person: he left Daliang on the 21st day of the third month of Xian De 4, reached Xia Cai at the end of that month, crossed the Huai on the night of the 4th day of the fourth month, attacked on the 5th and stormed the camp on the 7th, then pursued the broken enemy more than two hundred li to Jingshan Hong. His way with commanders was hard: even after the camp fell he still split his force to garrison the newly won positions. The Zizhi Tongjian records that officers Fan Aineng and He Hui reported the taking of the Zijin Mountain camp, that Chai Rong sent men to check, that the two were found gambling in a gaming house, and that they were beheaded before the army. The case of Li Gu is of the same order: sick in bed, he still advised that Shouchun was about to fall and that only the emperor's own presence would settle it, and that advice produced the second personal campaign. On the Southern Tang side, the commanders undid themselves. Li Jing asked his ministers again and again whether he should campaign in person, and was told each time that he should not. The Qi prince Li Jingda was commander of the relief army yet was under the thumb of Chen Jue, and fifty thousand men in his camp showed no fight at all. The general Zhu Yuan, distrusted and stripped of his command, took an entire camp of more than ten thousand men over to the Zhou, and his deputy Shi Houqing was killed for refusing to surrender. The garrison commander at Shouzhou, Liu Renzan, held out for over a year and by the end was so ill that he could no longer recognise people; the surrender was made in his name by the surveillance commissioner Zhou Tinggou and the camp-fields deputy Sun Yu, and his son Liu Chongrang came out of the city to receive the imperial edict. Zhao Kuangyin was the sharpest point of the whole operation, breaking the forward camp as vanguard and enforcing discipline with the leather cap, executing the men who would not fight.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛，兩米長的木槍、槍尾包銅，是重裝方陣步兵的標準長兵；它並未出現在紫金山的戰場上，此戰的實際裝備是另一套體系。禁軍步兵配大矛與長刀，弓弩居中，披札甲、戴皮帽，配大盾與拒馬；趙匡胤督戰時以劍砍不力戰士卒的皮帽，斬之以肅軍紀，說明皮帽在五代軍中同時是護具與辨識記號。攻城器械是這一戰的第二主角：壕溝、營壘、雲梯、撞竿、攻城塔，以及最吃緊的攻城技術——南唐在紫金山寨與壽州之間掘地道輸糧，長達數十里，後周先鋒奪寨的同時截斷甬道，等於用工程手段切斷了對方的補給線；另一端是水軍裝備，柴榮在汴河造數百艘戰艦、由南唐降將教習水戰，浮橋以麻索鐵索連舟而過淮，南唐則備火船欲逆流焚橋，張永德又在浮橋前江面架起千餘尺的鐵網阻擋南唐舟師；顯德三年十一月下蔡之役，周軍更令善泳者潛以鐵鎖繫住南唐戰船，使舟不能動搖，溺死者無算。糧秣靠船運，築城靠徵發的丁夫：四月九日柴榮調附近縣丁夫數千人為鎮淮軍築城，淮河南北各一座。
kitsEn: The card's weapon, the Spartan dory, is a two-metre wooden shaft with a bronze-shod butt, the standard long arm of a hoplite phalanx; it did not appear on the battlefield of Zijin Mountain, where the real equipment belonged to a different system altogether. Zhou infantry carried long spears and long knives, with bows and crossbows in the middle distance, wearing lamellar armour and leather caps and fighting with large shields and caltrops. Zhao Kuangyin's habit of cutting the leather caps of men who would not fight, and executing them, shows that in a fifth-century army the cap was at once armour and a mark of identity. Siege equipment was the second protagonist of this campaign: trenches, camp works, scaling ladders, battering rams and siege towers, and above all the craft of mining - Southern Tang dug a tunnel tens of li long from the Zijin Mountain camp toward Shouzhou to move grain, and the Zhou vanguard cut the gallery while taking the camp, severing the supply line with engineering rather than with steel. The other end of the war lay in river equipment: Chai Rong had several hundred warships built on the Bian and had Southern Tang defectors drill his men in water fighting; the pontoon bridge was carried across the Huai on hemp ropes and iron chains; Southern Tang prepared fire ships to burn the bridge on the upstream run, and Zhang Yongde set up an iron net more than a thousand chi wide on the river in front of the bridge to keep Southern Tang boats away. In the Xia Cai action of the eleventh month of Xian De 3, the Zhou men who could swim slipped iron chains onto the Southern Tang hulls so the ships could not move, and the drowning could not be counted. Grain moved by boat; walls were built with corvée labour: on the 9th day of the fourth month Chai Rong summoned several thousand corvée labourers from the counties round about and built two walled posts for Zhenhuai Jun, one on each bank of the Huai.
tactics: 南唐在紫金山佈的是連環寨：十餘座城寨像串珠一樣排開，寨與寨之間以塹壕相連，北接壽州，南望濠州，既是援軍宿營地，也是南唐江北防線的支點。配合這套陣地的是兩種手段，一是掘地道，由城外往壽州方向挖進數十里以通糧道；二是依託長江與淮河的水路聯動，濠州、泗州的舟師可沿河上溯支援壽州，壽春危急時，南唐將領甚至備火船準備燒燬周軍浮橋。後周的戰法是典型的節點攻堅加追擊殲滅：先以趙匡胤為先鋒奪取南唐先鋒寨與紫金山北面一處軍寨，斷其甬道，使紫金山寨與壽州守軍不能相救；主力隨即合圍紫金山本寨，寨破之後不急於休整，馬上轉入追擊，柴榮自領數百騎沿淮河北岸追，其他將領沿南岸追，趙晁的水軍順流而下，三面夾擊潰兵，把逃者趕入正在漲水的淮河。四月初七追到荊山洪，距出發的趙步已有二百餘里，隨後又把下蔡浮橋移到鎮淮軍，在淮河南北各築一城控扼水路，截斷濠州、壽州再出兵的可能。節制方面，柴榮留王朴守東京，張美、韓通分領大內與京城巡檢，軍令禁止士卒割損民田稼穡，處處以穩住軍心與糧道為先。
tacticsEn: Southern Tang laid out a chain of camps at Zijin Mountain: more than ten stockades strung like beads, linked by ditches and ramparts, reaching north to Shouzhou and looking south to Haozhou, serving both as the quarters of the relief army and as a hinge of the Southern Tang line north of the Yangtze. Two methods worked with that ground: mining, in which a gallery was driven tens of li from outside the camp toward Shouzhou to carry grain; and water mobility, for the fleets at Haozhou and Si County could work up the river to relieve Shouchun, and when Shouchun was in danger the Southern Tang commanders even prepared fire ships to burn the Zhou pontoon bridge. The Zhou method was textbook - strike the node, then finish the broken enemy. First Zhao Kuangyin as vanguard took the Southern Tang forward camp and one stockade north of Zijin Mountain, cutting the gallery so that the camp and the garrison of Shouzhou could no longer support each other; the main body then closed on Zijin Mountain itself, and once the stockade fell there was no pause for rest but an immediate pursuit, Chai Rong himself leading several hundred horsemen along the north bank of the Huai, the other commanders along the south bank, and Zhao Chao's river troops running down with the current, so that the three lines pinched the fugitives and drove them into a Huai in flood. On the 7th day of the fourth month the pursuit reached Jingshan Hong, more than two hundred li from Zhao Bu where it had started; the pontoon bridge was then shifted from Xia Cai to Zhenhuai Jun, and a walled post built on each bank of the Huai to hold the water road and cut off any fresh march out of Haozhou or Shouzhou. On discipline, Chai Rong left Wang Pu to hold the eastern capital, gave Zhang Mei and Han Tong the inner and outer patrols of the capital, forbade the troops to cut the people's standing crops, and put the keeping of morale and of the grain road before everything else.
data: 可核對的數字多出自《資治通鑑》與《舊五代史》系年，兵家報功向來有誇張之處，宜作量級看待。顯德四年二月，南唐齊王李景達遣永安節度使許文稹、督軍使邊鎬與北面招討使朱元等率軍數萬沿淮河逆流上援，李重進迎擊，南唐軍大敗，陣亡約五千，失兩座軍寨。四月初五，趙匡胤為先鋒攻南唐先鋒寨與紫金山北軍寨，全勝，陣斬三千餘人，並截斷對方未成形的甬道。初七，柴榮駐軍趙步（淮河北岸），各路將領合圍紫金山寨得手，南唐軍被陣斬上萬，許文稹、邊鎬、楊守忠等將領全部被擒；李景達所部五萬人，戰死、淹死與投降合計四萬餘人，周軍繳獲的戰船、糧秣與兵器以數十萬計。當日柴榮追到荊山洪，距趙步二百餘里。四月十九日周軍在壽州城北列陣，四月二十一日南唐方面出降，二十三日舉行受降儀式。壽州自顯德二年（955）冬被圍起至城破，前後約一年半。周軍的準備包括在汴河造數百艘戰艦並以降將教習水戰，另在淮上維持可移動的浮橋。需說明的是，卡面年表把此役記為公元956年，而《資治通鑑》把紫金山寨的攻拔繫於顯德四年（957年）三月至四月，本篇據兩書並陳，以免與同年九月南唐援軍屯紫金山的記載相混。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked come mostly from the chronological tables of the Zizhi Tongjian and the Jiu Wudai Shi, and since commanders always exaggerated their credit they should be read as orders of magnitude. In the second month of Xian De 4, the Qi prince Li Jingda of Southern Tang sent the Yong'an jiedushi Xu Wenzhen, the supervision commander Bian Hao and the northern recruiter Zhu Yuan with several tens of thousands along the Huai to march upstream in relief; Li Chongjin met them, the Southern Tang army was badly beaten, about five thousand were killed and two stockades were lost. On the 5th day of the fourth month Zhao Kuangyin, as vanguard, attacked the Southern Tang forward camp and the stockade north of Zijin Mountain, won both, killed more than three thousand and cut the gallery the enemy had not yet finished. On the 7th, while Chai Rong was stationed at Zhao Bu on the north bank, the various commanders closed on the Zijin Mountain camp and took it: more than ten thousand of the Southern Tang were killed, and generals Xu Wenzhen, Bian Hao and Yang Shouzhong were taken alive. Of the fifty thousand men under Li Jingda, over forty thousand were killed, drowned or surrendered, and the Zhou seized warships, grain and weapons counted in tens of thousands. That same day Chai Rong pursued them to Jingshan Hong, more than two hundred li from Zhao Bu. On the 19th the Zhou army was drawn up north of Shouzhou; on the 21st the Southern Tang side came out and surrendered; on the 23rd the surrender ceremony was held. Shouzhou had been under siege since the winter of Xian De 2 (955) until it fell, roughly a year and a half in all. The Zhou preparations included several hundred warships built on the Bian with defectors teaching water fighting, and a pontoon bridge kept mobile on the Huai. One note on the record: the card's chronology places this campaign in 956, while the Zizhi Tongjian dates the taking of the Zijin Mountain camp to the third and fourth months of Xian De 4 (957); both are set out here so as not to be confused with the entry for the Southern Tang relief force that occupied Zijin Mountain in the ninth month of the same year.
cause: 打起來的緣由有遠有近。遠因是後周在北方的整合已經完成：高平之役之後，中原再無大敵，柴榮的目標從守禦轉為統一，五代十國中只剩南唐與北漢仍據江南與河東。柴榮不把南唐當成對等敵手，卻不能容忍它與其他割據政權並存，於是趁南唐內部權力傾軋、淮南久無戰備之際，把戰線一路推過淮河。近因是壽州。壽、濠、泗三州是南唐屏障長江的江北砥柱，奪下壽州，等於在淮河插進一枚釘子；但壽州被圍一年有餘，城不能下，南唐的援軍就必須在紫金山集結屯駐，試圖打通一條通往壽州的補給通道。因此紫金山成了雙方都不能放手的節點：後周要拔掉這根楔子，南唐要守住這條命脈。促使柴榮再度親征的直接動因是李穀的進言。將領們見南唐援軍勢大，多請罷兵，主帥一度猶豫；三月十二日柴榮派范質、王溥到病榻前問策，李穀答以「壽春馬上可以攻下，這時候只要陛下親征就行」。於是三月廿一日皇帝再出大梁。
causeEn: The reasons for the fighting are both distant and immediate. The distant cause is that the consolidation of the north under the Later Zhou was complete: after the battle of Gaoping there was no serious enemy left in the central plain, and Chai Rong's purpose had shifted from defence to unification, for of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms only Southern Tang and Northern Han still held the south of the Yangtze and Hedong. Chai Rong did not treat Southern Tang as an equal enemy, yet he could not tolerate its survival as one more regional state, and so he pushed the line across the Huai while the Southern Tang was torn by internal quarrels and long unaccustomed to war in Huainan. The immediate cause was Shouzhou. Shou, Hao and Si were the northern-bank pillars shielding the Yangtze; to take Shouzhou was to drive a spike into the Huai. But Shouzhou had been under siege for more than a year and would not fall, so the Southern Tang relief armies had to assemble and camp at Zijin Mountain, trying to open a supply road to Shouzhou. Zijin Mountain therefore became a node neither side could let go: the Later Zhou had to pull out the wedge, Southern Tang had to hold the artery. What moved Chai Rong to campaign in person again was the counsel of Li Gu. Seeing the strength of the Southern Tang relief force, officers petitioned to withdraw and the commander in chief hesitated; on the 12th day of the third month Chai Rong sent Fan Zhi and Wang Pu to the sick man's bedside to ask for a plan, and Li Gu answered that Shouchun was about to fall and that only the emperor's own presence was needed. On the 21st day of the third month the emperor left Daliang again.
impact: 這一仗的後果遠大於一場局部攻防。首先是戰略層面：紫金山寨既破，壽州隨即陷落，淮南三州的門戶洞開，後周在淮河兩岸取得趙步、鎮淮軍等據點並控制浮橋航線，攻守之勢從此易位，南唐再難成建制地向江北投送兵力。其次是南唐內部的崩塌：齊王李景達與中書使陳覺互不信任，將領朱元被逼反、整寨歸周，說明南唐的問題不在兵少，而在將帥不相能；李璟自食其果，一退再退，終於在顯德五年（958）割長江以北十四州、奉後周年號、稱臣去帝號。第三是對後周本身的塑造：柴榮以斬將立軍法、以散金帛賞善泳士卒、以禁軍嚴禁擾民的作風，鍛造出宋初禁軍氣象的雛形；此役之後，他才有餘力北伐幽州。第四是對卡面兵器的提醒：紫金山決出勝負的不是希臘式方陣的單兵對決，而是弩機、攻城工程、浮橋與水軍的組合。誠如斯巴達長矛所象徵的那樣，真正決定戰局的是長兵能否在正確的時機形成有效的進攻線；此戰中，後周把這條線從一座營寨拉到了整條淮河。
impactEn: The consequences of this fight reach far beyond a local action. First in the strategic sense: once Zijin Mountain fell, Shouzhou followed, the gate of the three Huainan prefectures stood wide open, the Later Zhou gained positions such as Zhao Bu and Zhenhuai Jun on both banks of the Huai and took control of the pontoon route, and the balance of offence and defence was reversed - Southern Tang could no longer send formed bodies of troops across the river to the north. Second came the internal collapse of Southern Tang: the Qi prince Li Jingda and the Secretariat emissary Chen Jue did not trust each other, and the general Zhu Yuan was driven into rebellion and brought a whole camp over to the Zhou, which showed that Southern Tang's problem was not a shortage of soldiers but commanders who could not work together. Li Jing ate his own fruit, retreated step by step, and in Xian De 5 (958) finally ceded the fourteen prefectures north of the Yangtze, adopted the Zhou calendar, and called himself a subject without the title of emperor. Third, the campaign shaped the Later Zhou itself: Chai Rong made military law credible by beheading commanders, rewarded swimmers who risked themselves with their own gold belts, and kept the imperial troops from preying on the people, and out of this came the outline of the guard armies that would mark the early Song; only after it could he turn north against Youzhou. Fourth, the campaign is a lesson for the weapon on the card: what decided Zijin Mountain was not a hoplite duel of single men but the combination of crossbows, siege engineering, the pontoon bridge and the river fleet. Just as the Spartan dory stands for the idea, what really decides a battle is whether the long arms can be brought into one effective line of advance at the right moment; in this campaign the Later Zhou stretched that line from a single camp all the way along the Huai.
result: 結局是明顯的：顯德四年四月初五至初七，後周先拔南唐先鋒寨與紫金山北軍寨，陣斬三千餘；初七合攻紫金山寨得手，陣斬上萬，許文稹、邊鎬、楊守忠被擒，李景達所率五萬人中戰死、淹死、投降合計四萬餘，繳獲船械糧秣以數十萬計，柴榮親率騎兵追出二百餘里至荊山洪。四月十九日周軍列陣壽州城北，二十一日南唐守軍以其主將劉仁贊之名出降，二十三日正式受降，歷時約一年半的壽州攻防以全城陷落告終，紫金山一線也隨之歸入後周。不過戰役的原始目標並未全部達成：南唐本國仍未稱臣，金陵未下，直到顯德五年（958）柴榮三度南征、兵臨城下，南唐才割讓十四州並稱臣。史家對此役勝負的歸因有兩說：一說歸於柴榮親自督戰、軍法森嚴、進退有節；一說歸於南唐將帥乖離、掣肘自敗。兩說並不矛盾——前者說的是執行的效率，後者說的是對手的結構性弱點，兩者疊加，才有了四月七日紫金山寨的崩潰。
resultEn: The outcome was never in doubt. Between the 5th and the 7th day of the fourth month of Xian De 4, the Later Zhou took the Southern Tang forward camp and the stockade north of Zijin Mountain, killing more than three thousand; on the 7th the combined assault on Zijin Mountain succeeded, more than ten thousand were killed, Xu Wenzhen, Bian Hao and Yang Shouzhong were taken alive, and of the fifty thousand men under Li Jingda more than forty thousand were killed, drowned or surrendered, with warships, weapons and grain seized in tens of thousands, Chai Rong himself leading the horsemen in pursuit for more than two hundred li to Jingshan Hong. On the 19th the Zhou army was arrayed north of Shouzhou; on the 21st the Southern Tang garrison came out in the name of its commander Liu Renzan; on the 23rd the surrender was formally accepted, and the siege of Shouzhou, which had run for about a year and a half, ended with the whole city in Zhou hands, the Zijin Mountain line following it. The original objectives, however, were not all met: Southern Tang itself had not yet become a subject, Jinling had not fallen, and only with Chai Rong's third campaign in Xian De 5 (958), when his army stood before the city, did Southern Tang cede the fourteen prefectures and call itself a subject. Historians give two accounts of what decided the battle: one lays the victory on Chai Rong's personal command, strict military law and measured advance; the other on the Southern Tang commanders' mutual distrust and their undoing of themselves. The two are not incompatible - the first describes the efficiency of the execution, the second the structural weakness of the opponent - and only together do they explain the collapse of the Zijin Mountain camp on the 7th day of the fourth month.
